releaseNotes: Fixed: a transaction with a long note broke the Dashboard list - the amount was printed one digit per line down the side of the screen
Fixed: choosing a subcategory renamed the category above it, so picking Fitness under Me left both boxes reading Fitness
Fixed: a category you deleted could come back on the next launch. The restore was re-creating it from the spreadsheet before your deletion had been sent, and it came back permanently
Your spreadsheet's App_Metadata tab now reports the truth. It had claimed app version 2.0.0 and schema version 1 since the day it was created, and Last Sync had read Never on every sheet ever made
Installs over the top of 3.6.0 or 3.7.0. From 3.5.0 or earlier you must still uninstall first, after syncing
